description: Defines the MojoVideoDecoder class, a renderer process VideoDecoder proxy that communicates with a GPU process MojoVideoDecoderService. Contains class declaration, member variables, and method signatures related to video decoding via Mojo IPC.

classes.name: MojoVideoDecoder
classes.description: A renderer process VideoDecoder proxy that communicates with a MojoVideoDecoderService in the GPU process, handling video decoding via Mojo IPC.

methods.name: MojoVideoDecoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the MojoVideoDecoder with task runner, GPU factories, media log, remote decoder, overlay info callback, and target color space.

methods.name: IsPlatformDecoder
methods.description: Returns whether the decoder is platform-specific.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with configuration, low delay flag, CDM context, and callbacks.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes a video buffer with a callback.

methods.name: NeedsBitstreamConversion
methods.description: Checks if bitstream conversion is needed.

methods.name: CanReadWithoutStalling
methods.description: Checks if decoder can read without stalling.

methods.name: OnVideoFrameDecoded
methods.description: Callback when a video frame is decoded.

methods.name: RequestOverlayInfo
methods.description: Requests overlay info, possibly for transitions.

methods.name: set_writer_capacity_for_testing
methods.description: Sets buffer capacity for testing purposes.
